Swara Bhasker's 'Padmaavat' Jauhar remarks spark protests and bounty offer

Actress Swara Bhasker's comments on the 'jauhar' (self-immolation) scene in the film 'Padmaavat' have led to protests in Agra. The Yogi Youth Brigade burned posters and announced a reward of ₹1.51 lakh for anyone who cuts off Bhasker's tongue. Bhasker had previously written an open letter about the film, stating her views on rape victims and the historical depiction of 'jauhar'. While some reports suggest her comments on rape victims were accurate, her remarks on 'jauhar' are considered incorrect by some.
